text: けんがくには　にゅうじょうりょうが　いるけど　じゃ…！

structure.jp: にゅうじょうりょうが　いるけど
structure.en: you need an entrance fee, but

patterns.name: 〜には
patterns.explanation: には after an action word says 'in order to do that'. けんがくには = 'in order to look around'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins on to what was just said and means 'but' or 'though'. にゅうじょうりょうが　いるけど = 'you need an entrance fee, though'.

patterns.name: 〜がいる
patterns.span: にゅうじょうりょうが　いる
patterns.explanation: This いる means 'to be needed', and the needed thing takes が. にゅうじょうりょうが　いる = 'an entrance fee is needed'.
